headline: Stlican and Expanse Pace Slows; Passage Returns to Ledger
war_summary: Since the last edition, the double-digit pace of the latest two-hour file has slackened. Stlican Shelf now counts four strategic-base changes in the newest two-hour view and the Weathered Expanse three, down from eleven and nine at the prior cutoff; Callahan's Passage, absent from the previous two-hour file, returns with four. The six-hour and twenty-four-hour ledgers still point to the same contested ground: Weathered Expanse records 17 events in six hours and 60 in twenty-four, Stlican Shelf 20 and 53, and Callahan's Passage six and 20. Linn Mercy, Viper Pit, and Marban Hollow have not logged a base change in the past six hours, while DeadLands has seen none since 02:45. The heaviest twenty-four-hour casualty totals sit on the Weathered Expanse—roughly 9,200 Colonials to 10,600 Wardens—with Linn Mercy, Callahan's Passage, and Stonecradle also in the thousands. Enlistment rates are accelerating at Stlican Shelf, Linn Mercy, and Stonecradle, while cooling on the Weathered Expanse. No conquest has yet been declared; thirty-four victory towns remain required.
